usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and GoodDay gets work through “Create Task in Project” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Task in Project” in GoodDay
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order becomes a task with assignee, priority and schedule, so someone owns the follow-up.

watchOut: “Create Task in Project” needs a selected project, so pick it before you turn on “Order Cancelled”.
